newsitem.title: UK: British Steel down as NatWest repeats "sell".
newsitem.headline: British Steel down as NatWest repeats "sell".

text.p: Shares in British Steel Plc fell on Tuesday as NatWest Securities repeated a "sell" recommendation following Monday's half-year results, traders said.
The shares were down 2-1/2p at 169-1/4p by 1543 GMT, near the year's low of 160-1/2p set July 16.
Analysts at NatWest were not immediately available for comment, though market sources said the sell rating reflected the impact of the strong pound on the company's profits.
British Steel said on Monday that pre-tax profits more than halved to 262 million pounds in the first half of 1996 and warned that the strength of the pound had eroded its cost competitiveness.
A strong pound also depresses the value of UK companies' overseas earnings once they are translated back into sterling.
